parameters.name: Comments
parameters.description:
The description.

The description can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description:
The display name of the RAM user group.

The name can be up to 24 characters in length.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description:
The name of the RAM user group. You must specify this parameter.

The name can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ims create-group --display-name Dev-Team --comments '开发团队' --group-name Dev-Team --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ims CreateGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName 'Dev-Team' --Comments '开发团队' --DisplayName 'Dev-Team'
